Marta — thanks for the info and the W-9. A few quick asks so we can finish vendor activation on our side: 

1) Bank evidence: for payments we require a bank-signed letter on bank letterhead that matches the account number + company name. The draft is helpful but Finance needs the bank's confirmation (bank rep name and phone or a signed PDF). Can GreenFront request that and share as "bank-letter_signed.pdf"?

2) Micro-deposit check: our payments team may send two micro-deposits (under $0.50 each) to confirm the ACH. Please confirm if you prefer we use the account for a live test charge once we send the micro-deposits.

3) Remittance format: we support two options — (A) flat CSV with columns invoice_number, invoice_date, po_number, amount, remit_notes; or (B) an XML payload following our remit schema. If you can attach a sample XML that maps your invoice fields to the PO, that speeds things up.

4) PO process: when we create the vendor record we'll populate the default PO label (vendor internal id + short name). Please confirm the billing address exactly as it should appear on POs and whether invoices should reference a purchase order model or self-billing.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.net/link/abc123-GF-W9 (I see W-9 completed)

If you can get the signed bank letter and a remittance sample, I'll loop in Payments to run micro-deposit verification and finalize the onboarding.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
